picks.why: replaces the 1683 Mallet plate: a wide, high-resolution colored general view of the whole town (4760 px) instead of Mallet’s small upright plate; trimmed below the legend text in the sky

gaps: P0, P1: nothing usable (firman, Ardabil carpet); P3: only a 15-panel Homann sheet, too small per view; P4: nothing; P5: only a close-up of the Sheikh Safi shrine tower from Sarre’s 1924 book, photo date doubtful (likely taken around 1900); P6: only a fisheye shrine-courtyard panorama and mountain landscapes
notes: The Bouttats print is dated about 1674 by the Rijksmuseum.
